optimized_sql:
SELECT i_item_id, 
       AVG(ss_quantity) agg1, 
       AVG(ss_list_price) agg2, 
       AVG(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, 
       AVG(ss_sales_price) agg4 
FROM store_sales 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM customer_demographics 
      WHERE cd_gender = 'F' 
      AND cd_marital_status = 'W' 
      AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS cd 
  ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM promotion 
      WHERE (p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N')) AS p 
  ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk 
JOIN (SELECT * FROM date_dim 
      WHERE d_year = 2001) AS d 
  ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
JOIN item 
  ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
GROUP BY i_item_id 
ORDER BY i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
